final_classification: HELD-OUT PREPARATION PACK CONTAINS SCIENTIFIC CONTRACT ERROR
final_classification_rationale: The held-out preparation artifacts and authorization matrix contain multiple direct contradictions of frozen scientific and engineering contracts: (1) Criterion 3 asserts PySR search grammar includes 'exp', which directly violates Amendment A3.1's explicit exclusion of 'exp'; (2) Criterion 5 asserts '30 compounds x 6 energies', which directly contradicts the frozen 180-compound geometry in generator.py; (3) MURU_HELDOUT_RESULT_SCHEMA.md and MURU_HELDOUT_FAILURE_RESUME_MATRIX.md invent 6 non-canonical AcceptanceStatus enum names and 3 pseudo falsification rungs that conflict with structural_acceptance.py (10 AcceptanceStatus states and 6 FalsificationRung rungs); (4) Criterion 5 states case IDs 'PB|DEV|F01|000' which raises ValueError under registry.py resolve_case_id; (5) MURU_HELDOUT_RESULT_SCHEMA.md declares an incorrect schema_version. These discrepancies must be corrected before the preparation packet can be authorized for use.
